_about: Codex on the local model (demos 6.5 and 7.1). bin/codex-local and bin/run-baseline give these settings as `codex -c key=value` for one process only. They change no shell profile and no file in ~/.codex. The settings are the profile that `ollama launch codex` writes (Ollama 0.40.16): a provider for the Ollama Responses API and a model catalog. codex_home is a separate Codex home with no ChatGPT sign-in, so no request can go to the plan, and Codex cannot write to ~/.codex/config.toml. {model}, {base_url}, {catalog}, and {context_length} come from ollama.json, this file, and codex-models.json. Sources: https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/codex (checked 2026-11-17), and the files that `ollama launch codex --config` writes.
